Privacy Policy for Turbo Track

Last updated: August 17, 2026

Introduction

Turbo Track respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information is handled when you use the Turbo Track mobile game.

Information Collection

Turbo Track does not intentionally collect, store, or share personal information from users.

Third-Party Services

The current version of Turbo Track does not include advertising services or other third-party services that are intended to collect personal data.

Children's Privacy

Turbo Track does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated in the future if the game changes, including if new features or third-party services are added. Any changes will be posted on this page.

Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact the developer through the Google Play store listing for Turbo Track.
